topics.title: Unusual Grooming Rituals
topics.summary: A man describes his peculiar relationship with a lover, detailing specific grooming habits including frequent wiping and the use of gym shorts. He repeatedly states "I’m going to take a movie over it" during the conversation as he expresses frustration.

topics.title: Street Youth and Covenant House
topics.summary: A young man recounts his experiences living on the streets of New York after running away at age fourteen, detailing struggles for survival. He describes a brief encounter with Father Ritter while volunteering at covenant house where he taught children to read.

topics.title: McMahon’s Pursuit of Marcy Thompson
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss a bizarre situation involving Ed McMahon pursuing a young Hollywood model named Marcy Thompson with an offer of $80 million and marriage proposals. The conversation quickly devolves into speculation about McMahon's behavior, including alleged attempts to coerce Marcy into a sham wedding and his obsession with her appearance.

topics.title: Hair Color Troubles and Financial Claims
topics.summary: Howard discusses his friend Allison’s repeated, expensive hair color changes while the hosts delve into Morton Downey Jr.’s bankruptcy claims. They then attempt a phone survey with listeners discussing personal finances and offering unsolicited advice on lifestyle choices before abruptly ending.

topics.title: Phone Poll & Exercise Tape Chaos
topics.summary: A radio host conducts a survey on controversial topics like flag burning and sex before marriage, quickly derailing into tangents about celebrity gossip – specifically Jacob Schmearnoff’s Rolls Royce and medical procedures. The conversation then shifts to an exercise tape from ‘John Cardinal O’Connor,’ featuring bizarre commentary and claims of exorcism for physical purification.

topics.title: Cardinal O’Connor and Listener Calls
topics.summary: The broadcast features a series of callers discussing claims about Cardinal O’Connor, involving alleged devil possession, secret tunnels, and bizarre encounters. The conversation shifts to humorous observations regarding church practices like sprinkling holy water and wearing robes flown in from Fredricks of Hollywood, with some listeners expressing skepticism.
